body.p: After . Owns src/regex.c, src/regex_internal.h, tests/regex_test.c. : a backtracking matcher for a subset of the dialect (classes, \s \d \w, quantifiers, groups, alternation; flags s i x m) with a step limit, behind the interface the engine keeps. Done when fn-tokenize-1a, -35 pass and unsupported syntax raises FORX0002. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Regular expression syntax". Done 2026-10-16: hand-written parser, not tree-sitter (); also src/regex_unicode.c (\d, \w from Unicode 16.0) and tools/generate-regex-tables.py.
